interpretation: Latency summaries are medians/ranges of per-run p95 values, never pooled percentiles or confidence intervals.

Every scheduled measured-cohort operation contributes latency, including acknowledgements after the nominal window end. Missed slots and incomplete cycles fail.
Both arms sustain the same staggered offered rate: one read/save cycle per actor every five seconds; this is one rate point, not a capacity limit.
A comparison alone does not establish supported capacity; assess the complete correctness, volume and recovery evidence.

limitations: One offered-rate point: ten distinct actors, one cycle per actor every five seconds, two cycles per second total. Not a capacity limit.
Three repetitions per arm on the shared normal-service VPS. Observed ranges are not confidence intervals.
Every offered measured-cohort operation contributes latency, including acknowledgements past the nominal window end.
Whole-window CPU/SQL/WAL counters include initialization, warmup, final reads, background work and observer overhead.
PostgreSQL counters can lag; sparse backend/lock/resource samples cannot establish exact peaks or Ecto connection lease occupancy.
Generator CPU is percent of one core on a 24-logical-CPU workstation; memory percentage uses the sampled container limit. System load includes unrelated workstation activity.
